items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay said not making great progress but not long-term concern.
items.why: Team calling it hip; cautious approach
items.implication: Likely questionable or out for Week 3; elevates Adams
items.opportunity: Davante Adams 142 routes/42% target rate without Nacua

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day with hamstring injury.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 3 again
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes targeted / 28% team target share last week without him

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected knee surgery; full recovery but ends 2026 season. ACL intact.
items.implication: Season over; Giants seek QB options

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers not practicing second straight day (hamstring); looking like miss second consecutive game. Brazil trip complicates.
items.why: Hamstring origin Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half
items.implication: Likely OUT Week 3 vs DAL in Brazil

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.implication: Likely active; reverse any handcuff elevation

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Trevor Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back; waiver/handcuff Dillon

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in two missed games: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025; 8-195-2 vs NYG.
items.why: High route/target share data when Nacua out
items.implication: Strong WR1 upside if Nacua misses

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson first-quarter fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Patriots backfield 65% snaps and out-touched him 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3; team distrusts Henderson pass pro.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games with Michael Penix: over 20 PPR pts, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game. Penix return boosts.
items.implication: Strong WR1 with healthy Penix (TNF showed offense different)

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% routes, team-high 28% target share. Week 3 vs Colts (4th-most yds to TEs). Love.
items.implication: Strong TE start if Collins out again

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 util (86); PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: even with Kamara active ranked RB37 util; only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps. Role not there.

Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV high YPR to WRs); Parker Washington vs NE (36% tgt share); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ tgts); Dalton Schultz @ IND.
